scope: Read-only observations from byte/SHA-verified scalar records. Scores are unchanged. A decision is paired with the next state 50 ms later. First near-worktop loss is the first sampled positive cumulative count, not a continuous contact time. The first outside reading may be a transient droplet that returns. No individual particle trajectories are recorded, so timing alone does not establish causation. Zero-source delay starts at the final uninterrupted sampled zero-inventory stretch; it is a diagnostic, not a new pass/fail rule. Negative values mean the stop command preceded complete emptying, which may satisfy the declared near-empty tolerance. Volumes are nominal particle-count mL, not calibrated physical volume.
